'''Ferrin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who worked as an [[Imperial Agent|agent]] in the employ of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was stationed aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agent Ferrin appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a PvE gear vendor for the Imperial Agent class on Vaiken Spacedock, though he was later removed in a reorganization of the gear system.<ref name="TOR" />
